lessons.role: Introduce Aki to a study group
lessons.opening: こちらは あきさんです。グループの あたらしい メンバーです。
objectives: Introduce the new member and ask about a book preference
Recall yesterday’s library meeting with polite past forms
Discuss tomorrow’s study intention and how the earlier study went
lessons.complication: A group member asks whether Aki plans to visit the library again tomorrow.
lessons.closure: Invite Aki to study together with the group.

lessons.role: Check a supply note with a classmate before the first class
lessons.opening: あしたの クラスに ノートを にさつ もってきてください。
objectives: Read the requirement for two notebooks using ～さつ
Ask which additional supplies must be brought
Use ～てください to repeat the polite bring-this request
lessons.complication: The classmate confuses two notebooks with two loose items.
lessons.closure: Confirm the full list before leaving for class.

lessons.role: Distribute notebooks and pens to a group of three
lessons.opening: きょうは さんにんで べんきょうします。
objectives: Count three people and the notebooks needed
Name who gives or receives each item
Check that every person has the materials before starting
lessons.complication: One classmate thinks another person received the last notebook.
lessons.closure: Confirm that all three group members have their materials.

lessons.role: Check on Ken with another classmate
lessons.opening: けんさんは がくせいです。
objectives: Identify Ken as a student
Describe his present tired state with つかれています
Ask where he is separately from who he is and how he feels
lessons.complication: The classmate answers the location question with Ken’s role instead.
lessons.closure: Confirm Ken’s location and the plan to call later.

lessons.role: Describe a meeting room to a colleague
lessons.opening: へやの なかに つくえが あります。
objectives: Locate objects using あります
Locate people using います
Describe the light’s on-state with ついています
lessons.complication: The colleague asks whether a person or an object is near the desk.
lessons.closure: Restate where the relevant objects and people are before the meeting.

lessons.role: Clarify directions to meet a teacher near the station
lessons.opening: あした、えきの まえで あいますか。
objectives: Confirm tomorrow’s meeting place and time
Say that you do not know the route and ask about a map
Check whether you can travel the road and arrive alone
lessons.complication: The first directions are not enough for you to identify the route.
lessons.closure: Confirm the route and whether you can get there on your own.

lessons.role: Explain a method for learning difficult words to a classmate
lessons.opening: まいにち どうやって にほんごを べんきょうしますか。
objectives: Ask how a classmate studies using どうやって
Describe asking a teacher and writing sentences again
Explain gradual progress with すこしずつ
lessons.complication: The classmate gives only a daily time, so ask for the method instead.
lessons.closure: Restate the repeatable study method in order.

lessons.role: Reply to Aki’s written plan for Saturday
lessons.opening: あきさんから メッセージが きました。
objectives: Identify the proposed day, time, and place in Aki’s message
Compose a short reply with exact quoted words inside 「」
Confirm the meeting and mention the Friday night call
lessons.complication: The reply lacks a meeting place on the first attempt.

lessons.role: Compare two bags with a shop clerk
lessons.opening: この あおい かばんは いくらですか。
objectives: Ask the price of the blue bag
Compare the two bags using demonstratives and adjectives
Choose one bag and explain why it fits
lessons.complication: The clerk quotes the other bag’s price with さんぜん.
lessons.closure: Identify the chosen bag explicitly before buying it.

lessons.role: Identify the owner of a found umbrella
lessons.opening: この かさを みつけました。だれのですか。
objectives: Ask whose umbrella was found
Describe distinguishing details before returning it
Use the て-form to link looking at the umbrella with the owner’s response
lessons.complication: More than one person thinks the umbrella may be theirs.
lessons.closure: Return the umbrella to its identified owner politely.
